description: Axes du projet de développement des routes et des voies ferrées De Westhoek is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Vlaamse Landmaatschappij. road axes, digitized from NGI top maps 1/10,000 for the land development project De Westhoek. Coverage: Vlaamse Landmaatschappij. The portal shows the English title as "Axes of roads and railways land development project De Westhoek" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Vlaamse Landmaatschappij. Its keywords include WEGSPOORWEG, AUTOWEG, PAD, LANDINRICHTINGSPROJECT, STATION, BUURTSPOORWEG. The listing shows 1999-01-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
